- **The web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from any phone or computer on the same network, your first visit lets you take the root certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice, all there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?

- **And I can** schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing before we start: you haven't told me my name or how to speak of myself yet — would you like to keep **Professor Alvarez**, and shall I be neuter (they/it)?
